body: feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says emerald flecks came from the orchard treatment; the horse kicked away its feed before the crossing was barricaded.
title: weathered bundle note — during the hot afternoon
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the emerald flecks while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: The bank after closing
body: The fishing party was told to wait for a boat after the bridge closed. A patrol crossed upstream with room aboard, but its passenger sheet was filled out already. We waved a tackle box until our arms hurt.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
